✔ VERSATILE ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY: The ASENTE 5 LED LED crystal light stand can be operated with AC/USB adapter (included) that plugs into a computer, car, or electrical outlet. energy saving: high-quality LEDs with 10,000 hours of light using small power.
